Here is a transcription of the historical parish register entries shown in `image_1e7304.png`.

The document contains records written in Latin from the year **1860**, split across two pages. Because the handwriting features tight, cursive Latin script with standard genealogical abbreviations (such as *filius/filia* for son/daughter, *de* for "of" indicating townlands, and *suscipientes/suscep.* for godparents/sponsors), some specific local placenames or surnames are transcribed with the closest reading of the penmanship.
